title: Snapshot harness health for cleanup evidence
narrative: Taloneth starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`. Taloneth captures unused extensions, dead soft points, and unexercised routes as a harness-health snapshot so cleanup can be scheduled by the host. Accepts WalkingLabs L02 and L12 guidance[^wl-l02-health][^wl-l12-health].
implementation: `HarnessHealthSnapshot` and `needs_cleanup` in `mechaharness.harness_health` provide the optional health schema.
validation: Harness `user_story` drives product verb(s) with environment `pass_through`/`mock`; hard expects on declared observation keys.

footnotes.label: WalkingLabs L02 What a Harness Is
